rationale: Mutation of cro_asym_vol_ratio_med_20_minp3_vol6_ema2_001. Preserve core asymmetry ratio mechanism (window 20) and EMA2 smoothing from parent. Increase volume median window from 6 to 10 to obtain a smoother denominator for the volume ratio, reducing noise in the volume component. This targets improved IC by providing a more stable volume signal while preserving the high RankIC and RankICIR inherited from the parents. The change is a compact window adjustment.
